description: An endless encoder with four parameters and two speeds, standing in for a Kilpatrick Spinner USB controller

params.text: Chooses which of the four mapped parameters the encoder moves; hold M with the pointer over it to map that one, and hold L to switch it between momentary and latching
Turn it to move whichever of the four parameters is chosen; it has no end stops, so it goes on turning in either direction
Hold it down while turning the encoder to move the parameter in small steps
Hold it down while turning the encoder to move the parameter in large steps

notes: nothing happens until a control here is mapped: hold M with the pointer over it, then click the control in the patch it should drive
the hardware is chosen from the module's menu, and the choice is kept in the patch whether the hardware is plugged in or not, so a patch can be edited without it
clicking the panel away from a control blinks the USB lamp on the hardware, which is how you tell which of several units this module is driving
a Spinner Expander placed immediately to the right turns the four parameters into CV outputs and a vMIDI output
menu: MIDI Driver - Spinner Module — a heading over the MIDI drivers on this machine
MIDI Devices - Slot 1 — a heading over the devices found on the chosen driver; only Spinner hardware is offered
Subscribe to Kilpatrick-Toolbox — opens the maker's other plugin on the VCV library, which holds modules for the vMIDI cables these expanders send
www.kilpatrickaudio.com — opens the maker's page for the hardware in a browser
